stories.title: Tool Allowlist Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define the allowlist structure and binding between tool names and their corresponding Pydantic models, ensuring strict input validation contracts for each supported tool.

stories.title: Core Allowlist Routing Logic Enforcement
stories.description: Implement the core routing mechanism that checks incoming tool requests against the allowlist, blocks unauthorized tools, and maps valid tools to their execution handlers.

stories.title: Anthropic Tool Use Parsing and Dispatch Integration
stories.description: Parse Anthropic tool_use blocks from LLM responses and integrate them with the tool router, ensuring validated inputs are passed to the correct backend services.

stories.title: FastAPI Endpoint Integration with Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring chat requests trigger tool dispatch when appropriate and responses are correctly returned to the frontend.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Router Allowlist
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating allowlist enforcement, Pydantic validation behavior, tool dispatch correctness, and rejection of unauthorized tools.
